mentions.description: A toy computer and assembly language that runs via a Python interpreter. It is approaching its first release along with an introductory blog post, and was built as a fun way to learn more about real assembly.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a little toy computer and assembly language that's interpreted in python. Pretty close to the first release (and introductory blog post) and a lot of fun to build (and learn a bit more about real assembly as I go).
